text: Dracula moved to Italy. Worst decision of his afterlife. Garlic bread. Garlic pasta. Garlic in the coffee. Every grandma on the street carried a wooden spoon. He tried to bite a pizza chef. The chef bit back. Now Dracula runs a pizzeria. No garlic. Zero customers. One review. One star. From his mum. Pineapple or garlic on pizza? One has to go.
